rng: NumPy MT19937, seed reset per endpoint
primary1: Patient mean move minus rest normalized MVL; mean-bootstrap CI; two-sided t and Wilcoxon; fitlme ML default
primary2: Mean of rest/move sample SD per patient, APC minus MVL-Ozkurt; median-bootstrap CI and two-sided Wilcoxon
decisions: Supported if CI upper<0; Opposite if CI lower>0; Not shown otherwise. Not estimable denotes insufficient state data, not a decision.
sensitivity_b: Keep >=2.5 s with all other rules unchanged; report unestimable paired endpoints if no movement data
